variables.name: mimeType
variables.comment:
* The optional MIME type of the item, or {@code null} if unspecified. * *

The MIME type can be used to disambiguate media items that have a URI which does not allow * to infer the actual media type.

variables.name: streamKeys
variables.comment: Optional stream keys by which the manifest is filtered.

variables.name: customCacheKey
variables.comment: Optional custom cache key (only used for progressive streams).

variables.name: tag
variables.comment:
* Optional tag for custom attributes. The tag for the media source which will be published in
     * the {@code com.google.android.exoplayer2.Timeline} of the source as {@code
     * com.google.android.exoplayer2.Timeline.Window#tag}.
